status.html.title: Fleet Status — TheGMPTeam Studios
status.html.desc: Reconstruction of the production floor: nodes light up as if doing something. Simulation, not a live feed.
status.html.extra_head:
<style>
.hero{position:relative;z-index:20;text-align:center;color:#fff;padding:96px 0 6px}
.hero-hd{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.2em;font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3.4vw,2.3rem);margin-bottom:8px}
.hero-eyebrow{color:#7d90a8;letter-spacing:.26em;font-size:.66rem;text-transform:uppercase}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}
.dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#3fe0a0;box-shadow:0 0 12px #3fe0a0;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:middle;flex:0 0 auto}
#pills .dot{width:12px;height:12px;margin:0 6px 12px 0}
.pills{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;padding:14px 24px}
.dot-on{background:var(--cyan);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--cyan)}
.dot-ok{background:#3fe0a0;box-shadow:0 0 12px #3fe0a0}
.dot-am{background:#ffb347;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ffb347}
.dot-up{background:#3b8bff;box-shadow:0 0 12px #3b8bff}
.dot-st{background:#5a6472;border-color:rgba(138,152,175,.5)}
#stamp{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:.06em}
.hub-note{color:#ffb347;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:.78rem;opacity:.9}
main#simgrid{margin-top:30px}
.g{display:block;opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform .8s ease;min-height:100vh;scroll-snap-align:start;padding:120px 6vw}
/* After the auto-tour: sections pack closer together for the compact fleet view */
#simgrid.compact .g{padding:36px 6vw;min-height:0;scroll-snap-align:none}
#simgrid.compact{transition:all .5s}
.g.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
html{scroll-snap-type:y proximity}
#hud{display:flex;gap:22px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;background:rgba(1,3,10,.82);border:1px solid rgba(0,217,255,.25);padding:10px 20px;margin:26px auto 0;max-width:1100px;border-radius:10px;backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.g h2{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:1.4rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#00d9ff;margin-bottom:30px;text-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(0,217,255,.5)}
.g h2 .idx{color:#2b3a55;font-size:1.1rem}
.g h2::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,217,255,.55),transparent)}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(256px,1fr));gap:16px}
.node{position:relative;background:linear-gradient(165deg,rgba(11,18,32,.94),rgba(6,10,16,.88));border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:18px 18px 15px;transition:transform .2s, border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s;cursor:default}
.node:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--line-hot);box-shadow:0 0 34px rgba(0,217,255,.16)}
.node .top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.node .grp{font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.16em;color:var(--violet);text-transform:uppercase}
.node h3{font-family:'Orbitron',sans-serif;font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:8px;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.04em}
.node .ph{display:inline-block;font-size:.64rem;letter-spacing:.1em;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:5px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase}
.ph-up{background:#3b8bff;color:#fff}
.ph-te{background:#ffb347;color:#fff}
.ph-id{background:#3fe0a0;color:#fff}
.ph-su{background:#5aa9ff;color:#fff}
.ph-st{background:#5a6472;color:#fff}
.node .log{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;min-height:22px;transition:opacity .5s}
.node:hover .log{opacity:1}
footer.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding:24px 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:.75rem}
footer.site-footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
</style>
status.html.note: — FLEET STATUS · SIMULATION LOOP — this build is reconstructed for review; nothing here is live

@media (max-width:720px){
.hero{padding:48px 0 4px}
#hud{gap:8px;padding:10px 12px}
#pills{padding:4px 8px;justify-content:center}
#stamp{width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:.7rem;word-break:break-word}
main#livegrid .g{padding:26px 4vw}
.g h2{font-size:1rem;letter-spacing:.1em}
